description: Área de Prestación de Servicio de Acueducto y Alcantarillado Comunitario is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital del Hábitat - SDHT. Zona geográfica donde se presta el servicio de acueducto por parte de organizaciones comunitarias, auto abastecedores o pequeñas organizaciones, en áreas donde no tiene cobertura de servicio la Empresa de Acueducto y Alcantarillado de Bogotá EAAB, localizados en el distrito capital. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital del Hábitat - SDHT. Its tags are Acueducto, Hábitat, SDHT, Secretaría de Hábitat. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
